title: Psalms 79
paragraphs: ⁷² O God, the nations have invaded your inheritance; they have defiled your holy temple and left Jerusalem in ruins. ² They have given the bodies of your servants as food for the birds of the air, the flesh of your faithful ones to the wild animals. ³ They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one left to bury them. ⁴ We have become a disgrace to our neighbors, mocked and ridiculed by those around us. ⁵ How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

⁶ Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not know you, on the kingdoms that do not call on your name. ⁷ For they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland. ⁸ Do not hold against us the sins of our ancestors; let your mercy come quickly to meet us, for we are brought very low. ⁹ Help us, God our Savior, for the glory of your name; deliver us and forgive our sins for your name's sake. ¹⁰ Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Let the vengeance for your servants' blood be known among the nations before our eyes.

¹¹ May the groaning of the prisoners reach you; by the strength of your arm preserve those condemned to die. ¹² Pay back our neighbors seven times over for the scorn they have heaped on you, Lord. ¹³ Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever; from generation to generation we will tell of your praise.
